s: Service decomposition, communication, service mesh, observability
d: Microservices split a monolith into independently deployable services. They enable team autonomy and independent scaling but add massive operational complexity. Don't adopt microservices until your team and system genuinely need them.

p: Microservices is a critical component of modern backend architecture. It focuses on optimizing performance, ensuring reliability, and scaling the system to handle increasing loads efficiently. Mastering this allows you to build enterprise-grade applications.
1. Understand the core principles and trade-offs.
2. Evaluate open-source tools and industry standards.
3. Implement the pattern within your backend stack.
4. Monitor performance and adjust configurations as scale increases.
